what: Two thin lines slanting across the upper right of text buttons like Learn More — a dark 80px line (212°) and a gray 58px line (192°) — on hover they rotate to 240° and 114° over .3s ease, opening like scissors, and return on release
note: CSS only — since ::before and ::after are used, the element’s pseudo-elements are not used elsewhere. Letter spacing is left to the consuming side (original letter-spacing 6.72px · 12px)

from.where: shared.css .kt-learn (Learn More on the first-page About · Facility · Sights · Access bands) — original .c-button-toppage:before 80px #002D49 rotate 212→240 · :after 58px #B0ADAD 192→114 · transition rotate .3s ease
